en: A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing the grand façade of a multi‑storey brick hotel with ornate balconies, corner towers and mansard roofs. Large rooftop signs read "HOTEL" and "KEIZER KAREL". The entrance has a decorative canopy with additional signage, and there are trees, a small garden, and a street with a lamppost in the foreground. A separate sign on the left reads "GARAGE".
